Subject: Q3 Flagship Launch Readiness & Contingency

Team —

This thread pulls together a quick leadership/OKR pulse for the Q3 flagship roll-out (targeted GA: 2026-09-15). We need a concise cross-functional snapshot for tomorrow's QBR prep and a short contingency plan in case the reserved capacity cadence slips. My asks: 

1) GTM signoff (laura): confirm if training + sales enablement materials will be ready for the partner wave by 2026-09-01.
2) Enablement (laura / marissa): attach enablement_playbook_v1.pdf — please mark gaps and update the learner-flow.
3) Pricing & terms (ben): review the proposed contingency credits in sla_contingency_matrix.xlsx; we need a pricing fallback that keeps unit economics < 20% delta from plan.
4) Docs & release notes (marissa): we need the single-page release-notes handout and a short changelog.
5) Support readiness (monica / markus): confirm on-call ramp and escalation matrix.

Please reply inline with: 1) blockers (if any), 2) final owner for each ask, 3) whether you require exec approval for any contingency (if so call it out). I want a single slide summarizing status by end of day so I can take to QBR.

Attachments: enablement_playbook_v1.pdf (draft), sla_contingency_matrix.xlsx (workbook)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of GTM, Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Quick status from GTM / enablement:
- Training flow: we can deliver the instructor-led sessions and the on-demand playbook by 2026-09-02 (buffered a week).
- Risk: we need the final product slide deck (single features + ROI bullets) by COB Friday so enablement can finalize slides.
- Headcount ask: two temporary PMMs for launch week to handle partner ramp (I propose contractors; see enablement_schedule_v3.xlsx).

Blockers: none critical, but the deck and the final model spec from engineering are gating.

Owner assignments:
- Enablement playbook updates: Laura Bennett (owner)
- Training schedule: Laura / Marissa (co-owners)

Attachment: enablement_schedule_v3.xlsx (staffing & timeline)

On the contingency: if SAAS billing/throughput shows >15% latency increase for 2 consecutive days during partner ramp, we should move to the SLA contingency credits in the matrix and notify customers via the partner comms channel. That will require sign-off by Finance (ben) and Ops (monica).

Laura Bennett
Director, GTM Enablement

Karthik / team —

Pricing note: I reviewed sla_contingency_matrix.xlsx and sketched two paths:
A) Soft credit path: apply transient partner credits for the first 72 hours of ramp capped at $XK — requires Finance approval but keeps AR predictable.
B) Capacity re-route: temporarily upgrade partner traffic to Dedicated pool (short-term cost bump, but preserves customer UX).

Recommend A for channel partners and B for strategic direct customers. I put high-level estimates in pricing_paths_v2.pdf.

Related: the deal (ACME-2026-Q3-Flagship) will need a clause in SOW for accelerated support during the first 30 days; that's a legal/contract ask — I'm looping legal after this note.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-Q3-Flagship — please update the playbook stage if we proceed with the contingency credit option.

-Ben

Thanks all — clear progress and good trade-offs. Finalizing a one-slide summary now; highlights and owners below for the QBR deck: 

- Enablement: Laura (deliverable: final slide deck + on-demand playbook by 2026-09-02)
- Enablement staffing: Laura / HR to finalize contractors (see enablement_schedule_v3.xlsx)
- Docs: Marissa (deliverable: 1-pg release notes + changelog by 2026-09-03)
- Internal runbook: Kimberly Park (owner) to update runbook and incident escalation paths
- Pricing/Finance: Ben (owner) to propose credit cap and seek Finance sign-off; pricing_paths_v2.pdf attached
- Support/Ops: Monica & Markus (owners) to confirm on-call ramp and execute the contingency route if latency >15% for 48 hours

Contingency triggers: if partner ramp causes L4 error rate >1% or 95th p99 latency degrades >15% for two consecutive days, we will execute the Soft credit path and notify partners via the partner comms template.

Action items (due EOD tomorrow for QBR slide):
- Each owner to send a single slide (status, blocker, ask) to me.
- Ben to confirm estimated credit cap and escalation sign-off timeline.
- Marissa & Kimberly to decide GA vs post-GA for private deployment guide.

Patricia — copying you so Acme has visibility on the contingency approach and the expected comms cadence.

I'll pull this into the QBR pack and send for final review at 08:00 PT tomorrow. If anyone needs an exception on dates, call me directly.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of GTM, Redwood Inference
